messages:
jon-gray: Team — quick heads up: planning a 'deploy orchestra' for next Tue 02:00 UTC. This thread to assign slots, smoke owners, and rollback holders.
emily-k: I'll take app-service slot and do smoke checks. Can we keep canary at 5% initially?
marcos: I'll own the db migrations window (02:10-02:20). Migration is reversible with toggle flag.
liam: I'll be on rollback if migrations misbehave. What's the protocol? manual toggle + new pod rollout?
tina-ops: Confirming rollback plan: feature flag off -> scale down new instances -> deploy previous image. I'd like 30min hold for metrics.
jon-gray: Good. Marcos, add the migration script in the PR and ping me. Emily, add smoke checklist to the PR comment (latency, error-rate, kv-store warm).
emily-k: Will do — sample checklist:
```
smoke:
- /health
- /generate sample prompt
- p99 latency < 400ms
- errors < 1%
```
jon-gray: Perfect. deploy-bot: please create the wave and reserve the following slots: app-service, db-migration, cache-warm, canary-monitor.
deploy-bot: Created wave id: wave-2026-07-14-02, slots reserved.
marcos: Note: DB upgrade requires brief connection drain — schedule cache-warm before migrations so KV is primed.
emily-k: Agree. I'll start cache-warm at 02:05.
liam: I'll be on-call 02:00-03:00. Ping @liam if rollback needed.
jon-gray: Final ask: everyone add rollback playbook link to their PRs and set the canary alert to 3m evaluation window.
emily-k: Done. :thumbsup:
marcos: PR up, tests green.
liam: OK, flagged calendar invite for the wave. See you all.
